binding.operation: One owned operationId binds the already registered source expectation, full preservation/consent binding, exact actual artifact set, approved actual target/base/lease context and frozen comparison rules. A different source, owner, revision, purpose, target or candidate needs its own operation/validation. TargetDigest comes from actual authorized host context, not a display filename.
binding.receipts: Candidate semantic validation, actual host commit and persisted semantic validation are separate internal completions. Each carries exactly the same operation/binding/artifact/target/rule identities and its own immutable verificationId. Only the authenticated internal job registry can vouch for completion; the client cannot register a passed flag, fabricated ID or arbitrary expectation.
binding.source: Actual complete source expectations are fixed before output exists. Output hashes and receipts never redefine expected objects; empty Field output against the real512-value source must fail before a semantic completion is issued.
binding.host: Host commit receipt states only the supported existing primitive/durability/writer boundary. It does not invent power-loss/network-directory durability, global Shell fencing or external-writer CAS. D2-13 check/use limits remain; original/no04 qualification is not silently upgraded.
binding.targetRole: Capture existing versus unbound-new binding role in the owned target context before planning; targetDigest binds exact purpose/role/target and contextual authority. Existing receipt wire stays unchanged. No mayRebind client grant.

phases.candidate-pending: No public output. Fresh complete-source audit/consent/reference closure, owned resource leases and authenticated artifact-only candidate semantic completion required before publication.
phases.publishing: Dependencies-first/primary-last underway. Beginning visibility cannot be undone by a client cancel. Any ambiguous completion enters commit-unknown.
phases.commit-unknown: Preserve draft/dirty/old and new potentially reachable resources. No blind re-encode/retry, cleanup/rollback, rebinding, close or Saved. Query this owned host operation and actual persisted bytes; a positive byte comparison alone cannot invent a missing host operation receipt.
phases.not-published: An authenticated host outcome proves primary not published; retain prior authoritative draft/resources, cleanup only owned unreferenced private artifacts after readers finish.
phases.committed-unverified: Authenticated host commit binds exact candidate bytes but semantic restoration remains unconfirmed. Missing field/ref/unit/table or invalid source metadata keeps this state with diagnostics; no Saved/close/rebind/automatic rollback over possible outside edits.
phases.complete-for-captured-snapshot: Actual persisted bytes/reference resolution/typed source and semantic object coverage match the captured source expectation under authenticated verifier completion. Reuse prepublish semantic evidence only if every artifact/context/rule input is proven equal. Readback from live old Engine/CWD/caches is disallowed.
phases.cancelled-before-publication: No later stale candidate may publish. Only owned private cleanup after in-flight readers finish; original draft/resources remain.

lifetime.inflightEdits: Consent and pre-EncodeApproved submission validate the captured live identity. Once an approved job owns an immutable source snapshot and an exact save ticket, later edits do not mutate that input: completion can settle the captured revision only. Candidate not yet approved for publication must not be silently applied to a newer current snapshot; follow current coordinator/ticket validation. No stale result may mark the newer draft clean.
lifetime.Saved: A completed save/saveAs acknowledges the exact captured document/epoch/revision only. R7 ack cannot clear/close R8. Different document/epoch settles old ticket/history and cannot mutate currentWorkRef or resources.
lifetime.saveAs: Successful same-document/epoch operation may bind the actually acknowledged authorized target while dirty is recomputed against its captured revision. A changed revision remains dirty; different-lifetime completion never rebinds.
lifetime.export: Even complete export only confirms that export operation. No projectSaved, currentWorkRef rebinding, dirty clearing or project close.
lifetime.close: The close controller quiesces editing and resolves all in-flight/unknown operations, captures latest revision, then accepts only exact current lifetime/revision completion. Without quiescence an ack is not close authorization. Failure restores editing, retains draft/dirty. Hard close/crash does not promise unsaved RAM recovery.
lifetime.idempotence: Apply each owned operation completion once. Duplicate/late deliveries are checked against current lifetime and coordinator ticket; a previously consumed completion cannot grant a new close/rebind action.
lifetime.firstSave: An unbound new project gains the acknowledged actual WorkRef only after complete same-document/epoch first Save; different current revision stays dirty. Existing Save retains its original WorkRef. SaveAs rebinds only on its own exact acknowledged target; export never rebinds. See selectedSaveTargetPolicy and actual controlled-writer race boundary.

queryAndCancel.query: After lost ack/cancel during publication, resolve actual owned operation outcome. If committed, verify actual persisted primary/dependencies/reference graph/full semantics. If not published, prove that outcome. Conflicting/missing validator/source expectation/rules/host evidence stays unknown or explicit readonly recovery. Query does not call EncodeApproved or perform a write.
queryAndCancel.cancel: Before publication cancel prevents later begin_publish. During publication stop new work safely and resolve the possible commit, no promised rollback. After verified commit, retain resources reachable from committed output; a cancel cannot erase confirmed data.

proofBoundary.finiteModel: save-settlement-model.py models authenticated completion as a conditional immutable registry; no real host, IPC authentication, persistence, active Engine or filesystem race implementation.
proofBoundary.actualPayloadWitness: typed-source-restore-witness.py compares all512 held source words in an authored selected full-root DTO and missing-Field negatives. It is not actual native/product restoration.
proofBoundary.originalFailure: The actual original saved3515-byte project still failed fresh volumetric reopen. These contracts do not convert it into a native pass.

selectedSaveTargetPolicy.scope: D4-31 target selection and exact first-Save binding; selected source authority snapshot, no04 implementation
